name: Ettiene Wium
headline: Production software engineer moving into SRE / DevOps — Linux, AWS, Docker (Cape Town, remote)
location: Cape Town, South Africa · globally remote · SAST (UTC+2)
summary:
Production software engineer with 8 years of PHP and Linux. I moved from building client systems into DevOps: I own production pipelines, Docker, and AWS for clients. I want SRE next — keep services up, automate the boring path, and make 24/7 ownership not 24/7 firefighting. My current employer does not run large Kubernetes or SRE programmes, so I practise that work myself: a homelab where I self-host, operate a streaming service, and do the DevOps and SRE (k3s, Terraform, Docker).

Seeking a globally remote SRE or DevOps role with flexible hours. PHP/Laravel is paid production experience — not the headline I want next. Kubernetes is two years of homelab (k3s/k3d), not a cluster at work. Docker is eight years locally and four years in production.

ops: Docker (8 years locally; 4 years production — Indawo and other clients)

experience.title: Software Developer (production Linux / DevOps-leaning)
bullets: Own production PHP/Laravel (and custom PHP) on Linux for multiple clients: pipelines, deploys, MySQL on live databases, and incident follow-through — not only feature tickets.

Hardware-loss incident: a client PHP 5.6 host died (Indawo). Alone, I containerised the app with Docker onto a spare on-prem CentOS server, worked through publish/host networking, and restored the site. First production Docker — not a lab tutorial.
First contact when client production is wrong: logs, config, DNS/TLS, MySQL, restore service, then write down the actual cause.
Lead developer on SAWIS BI: large import/export jobs for the South African wine industry. When a job fails in production I diagnose the data path and recover it.
Ran Docker and AWS (EC2, Lambda, RDS, IAM, VPC) on Ubuntu hosts; stayed on standby. CI/CD to EC2 (CodePipeline, SonarQube). AWS DevOps Engineer Professional earned in this role.

experience.title: Junior to Mid-Level Developer
bullets: Shipped LAMP applications on Ubuntu and small AWS hosts; owned deployments, testing, and production issue resolution on Linux.
Built client systems, including an RBAC member dashboard (Global Self-Care Federation) and live JSE graphs on that stack.
Maintained WordPress sites (including usb.ac.za, waterfront.co.za): plugins, compatibility, DNS/TLS, and security reviews.
Also shipped an email builder and intranet microservices on the same LAMP stack (supporting work — not the lead).
